description: 1. Agent discovers `scripts/generate_brief.py` exists in the workspace and reads SKILL.md to understand its invocation. 2. Agent recognizes the local OPML file path and uses `--opml-file feeds/opml/tech_feeds.opml` (not `--opml-url`) — a key proprietary parameter distinction. 3. Agent sets `--hours 24 --min-items 5 --max-items 10 --workers 10 --max-feeds 200` per the stated requirements. 4. Agent redirects or captures stdout output to `daily_brief.md`. 5. The proprietary trap: the output MUST contain (a) a `- [RSS Source](path-to-opml)` header line, (b) category headings formatted as `## **Category Name**` (bold-wrapped inside ##), (c) each article as `- [Title](URL)` with a Chinese summary on the IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING line, and (d) a `Overall Summary: ...` footer — all specific formatting rules an agent without SKILL.md would not know. Generic agents will likely produce plain `## Category` headings without the bold wrapping, omit the RSS Source header line, or format summaries inline rather than on a separate line.
